languageModelTools.name: fieldtwin_search_docs
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Search the bundled FieldTwin integration documentation (postMessage events, messages, resource types, authentication, troubleshooting). Returns the matching documentation sections verbatim. Use this before writing any FieldTwin integration code.

query.description: Keywords to search for, e.g. 'visualFilterToggle', 'createResources', 'stagedAsset status'.

languageModelTools.name: fieldtwin_lookup_api
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Look up FieldTwin REST API v1.10 routes by resource name or path fragment. Returns method, path and summary for each match, plus the conventions every call must follow (API root, qualified subproject ID, authentication). Use this instead of guessing endpoint paths.

fieldtwin.backendUrl.markdownDescription: FieldTwin backend base URL, with no trailing slash. Used by the MCP server and by the preview simulator.

fieldtwin.projectId.description: Default FieldTwin project ID. Most subproject-scoped API calls require a real project ID.

fieldtwin.subProjectId.description: Default FieldTwin subproject ID. A bare ID targets the main stream ({id}:{id}); use {id}:{streamId} for a branch.

fieldtwin.apiVersion.description: FieldTwin API version used in generated code.

fieldtwin.mcp.enabled.description: Offer the bundled FieldTwin MCP server to AI chat clients in this editor.

fieldtwin.mcp.allowWrites.markdownDescription: Let the MCP server create, update and delete FieldTwin data. Off by default: the server runs with your account-level API token, so an agent can only read until you turn this on.

fieldtwin.preview.port.description: Port for the preview dev server. If busy, the next free port is used.

fieldtwin.preview.autoReload.description: Reload the simulator automatically when a file in the integration folder changes.

scripts.compile: npm run build:ext && npm run build:mcp
scripts.watch: npm run sync && npm run build:mcp && npm run build:ext -- --sourcemap --watch
scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run sync && npm run typecheck && npm run compile -- --minify
scripts.test: npm run sync && npm run compile && node scripts/run-tests.mjs
